$comment: SealLink v1.0 Canonical Artifact Identity Scheme Registry (SPEC-05, PROFILE-artifact-v1). target_id = target_sha256 = H_tag('seallink-artifact-id/1', JCS({'digest': digest, 'scheme': scheme})) strictly EXCLUDING params to prevent target_id splitting attacks.

schemes.description: Raw lowercase hex SHA-256 digest of an immutable byte stream (archive, binary, blob, or image).

Linux fs-verity SHA-256 Merkle root digest with canonical fixed parameters (version=1, block_size=4096, strictly empty salt_hex='') ensuring 1-to-1 file digest determinism across all hosts and kernels >= 6.3.
OCI image manifest or index SHA-256 digest (64 lowercase hex without 'sha256:' prefix).
Git SHA-256 tree object digest (64 lowercase hex).
Apple Mach-O / bundle SHA-256 Code Directory Hash (64 lowercase hex).
Curator CIP-0007/CIP-0008 canonical v2 content digest (64 lowercase hex).
